data.name: Pavithraj
data.gender_notes: Pavithraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Pavithraj is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pavithra' which means 'pure' and 'Raj' which means 'king'. This name signifies the one who is the ruler of the pure universe. It is a powerful and spiritual name in Hindu tradition. The name Pavithraj carries the meaning “Lord of the universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Pavithraj usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Pavithraj holds great cultural significance in Hinduism, as it signifies the one who Lord Shiva, the God of Purity, bestows upon with purity and divinity. It is believed that anyone named Pavithraj is blessed with the divine grace and blessings of the Lord, and is expected to lead a pure and righteous life. In many Hindu rituals, the naming ceremony of a child is an important event, and the name Pavithraj is given to those children who are born under auspicious circumstances.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Pavithraj lies in its deep connection to the Hindu concept of purity and divinity. The name denotes the one who rules over the pure universe, and is a constant reminder of the importance of leading a pure and righteous life. It is a powerful and spiritual name that carries the blessings of Lord Shiva, and is believed to bring peace, happiness, and prosperity to those who bear it. The name Pavithraj is a testament to the Hindu belief that purity and spiritual growth are the keys to a fulfilling and meaningful life.
